findings.title: Task 11's vent isn't 'away from the Q spawns': the held H–O door and the spawn-held Q–O door put the crew's room on the vented volume
findings.claim: The SCRIPT holds edge 2 open at tick 400 and opens airlock 0 (the Hold) from 420 to 900. The comment says the Hold is 'away from the Q spawns', but the crew's room isn't sealed off. On Hound, edge 2 is the H–O door. Player 0 spawns at (13,7), next to the Q–O door tile (12,7). That puts the crew's centre exactly DOOR_ZONE (1.0) from the door's centre, so doorSystem keeps that auto door Open the whole run. H, O and Q (about 65 tiles) therefore drain through AIRLOCK_PASSAGE = 3 for 8 s. By my rough estimate, Q falls below LOW_AIR_FRAC and both standing players take O2_DAMAGE (6 hp/s) from about tick 500 until well after 900. They lose an estimated ~70 hp by tick 1200. The 1200/1201 shipPower commands need `conscious(d, pid)`, so the new 'every command applies' assertion is only safe by a thin, unmeasured margin. The test's stated rationale is also wrong.
findings.evidence: plan L3423-3425 (the 'away from the Q spawns' comment), L3429 (edge 2 at 400, airlock 0 from 420 to 900), L3455 (statuses must all be 'applied'), L1223 (engineer requires conscious); hound.json:L80-L86 (edge 2 is H–O, tile [6,5]), L13 (row 7 has '+' at x=12, the Q–O door), L215-L217 (spawns [13,7], [14,7]); src/renderer/src/sim/tuning.ts:L16 (DOOR_ZONE 1.0, Chebyshev ≤), L22 (AIRLOCK_PASSAGE 3), L34 (O2_DAMAGE 6); src/renderer/src/sim/doors.ts:L20 (`<= DOOR_ZONE` keeps the door open); plan L1890-L1894 (low air hurts below 25 %, seated or standing).
findings.why: If the margin fails, every seed fails the same way at tick 1200 or 1201, with 'unavailable' from a downed player. The executor gets no guidance for that, and the fix that looks obvious (dropping the applied assertion) would undo R1-F4. Even if the test passes, its comment misdescribes what runs.
findings.fix: Hold a door that is off the crew's air path, for example `{ kind: 'shipDoor', edge: 1 }` (R–H): the Reactor vents with the Hold, and O and Q only leak through closed doors at PASSAGE_CLOSED. Or hold edge 2 only after the airlock closes (for example at tick 950). Also add `expect(Life.state[a.interior.crew[p]!]).toBe(LifeState.Conscious)` for both players at the end of each seed. Correct the comment.

findings.title: The new Decisions are numbered out of order, and one cited line range is off
findings.claim: Decisions 20 and 21 are placed before Decision 19. In rendered Markdown an ordered list numbers its items in sequence, so the item written as '20.' shows as 19, '21.' as 20, and '19.' as 21. The rendered view therefore disagrees with the plan's references to 'Decision 20' (Task 9b Step 7b) and 'Decision 21' (Task 12). Separately, Task 6 Step 5 says the tuning.ts fire doc comment clause 'spans lines 34 and 35'. In the source it spans L35-L36.
findings.evidence: plan L131-L137 (the order 20, 21, 19), L2992 and L3535 (references); plan L1466 vs src/renderer/src/sim/duel/tuning.ts:L35-L36 ('a fire grows DUEL_FIRE_GROW per tick to FIRE_CAP and never goes out by itself;').
findings.why: It's a nit. An executor reading the rendered plan could match the wrong Decision. The line range is only a pointer, since the edit is described by its text.
findings.fix: Move Decision 19 above 20 and 21. Change 'lines 34 and 35' to 'lines 35 and 36'.
